summary: Phase 2 admin mass-edit (/admin/products) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS covering: GET /admin/products (basic, admin-only 401/403, search hits, sort price asc/desc, /ids endpoint) and POST /admin/products/bulk (set_fields toggle is_original on/off, set stock 50→0→restore, set_fields apply discount + clear_discount, adjust_price 0% no-op, missing product_ids → 400, unknown action → 400, delete throwaway returns modified_count≥1 and GET→404). Frontend Playwright: login as admin@avarus.ru/admin → /admin/products shows '7 товаров'; search 'MANN' debounces to 2 rows, clearing restores 7; sort 'Цена ↑' first row 100 ₽, 'Цена ↓' first row 1 500 ₽; stock filter in=3 / out=4 / discounted=7; selecting a row reveals bulk-toolbar with 'Выбрано: 1'; badge-original-on then badge-original-off success toasts; availability 50 → out → 10 restored; discount apply (percent 15 until 2027-12-31) + remove-discount (confirm accepted); price-direction +, value 0, %, adjust → success no-op; select-page selects 7; clear-selection hides toolbar; edit-product-{id} opens product-edit-modal, save-product closes modal; /admin → Каталог tab → mass-edit-btn navigates to /admin/products; created throwaway 'TEST_DELETE_ME_UI' via API, searched + selected + bulk-delete (confirm) on /admin/products → product GET returns 404. Zero console errors throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminProductsPage.runBulk() calls clearSelection() + fetchProducts() after every bulk success, so a user must re-tick rows between consecutive bulk actions. UX-wise this is safe but slightly tedious for multi-step adjustments — consider preserving selection on success or offering an 'apply & keep selection' option.

Bulk apply-discount via set_fields with discount_value but no discount_until still passes (no validation that until is in the future). Backend accepts arbitrary date; consider 400-ing if discount_until < now or value <= 0 for percent mode.

Bulk adjust_price doesn't take a minimum-price guard — pipeline {$max:[0,...]} clamps to 0 which could silently zero prices on a large '−' adjustment. A check for resulting price > 0 (or returning the modified prices) would be safer.

Both /admin/products/ids and the bulk endpoint with apply_all rebuild the same filter (_build_admin_query) — that's fine, but no upper safety cap is applied to 'delete + apply_all' (apart from frontend confirm). Adding a server-side guard preventing apply_all+delete unless an explicit confirm token is sent would prevent accidental catastrophic deletes.

Frontend /admin/products initial render still uses a 'Загрузка...' placeholder on /admin parent route while AdminPage tabs mount — selectors for the 'Каталог' tab needed an extra wait (~2-3s). Consider exposing data-testid='admin-tab-catalog' to make automation/regression robust.
Bulk discount label control uses placeholder 'Распродажа' but `discount_label` is sent even when empty; harmless but consider trimming/skipping empty label.
seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture creates a TEST_MASS_EDIT_PRODUCT (TEST-ME-001) — toggled is_original on/off, stock 50→0→10, discount on→clear, price 0% no-op, then bulk-deleted in final test. Frontend Playwright created TEST_DELETE_ME_UI (TEST-UI-DEL) and deleted it via bulk-delete. Existing 7 catalog products had badge/discount/stock/price changes which were each reverted within the same test (final state matches initial). No persistent side-effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminProductsPage exposes data-testids: admin-products-page, admin-product-search (400ms debounce), admin-product-sort, admin-product-category, admin-product-stock-filter, admin-product-discounted-filter, bulk-toolbar, bulk-selection-count, select-all-matching (only appears when total>pageSize), clear-selection, select-page, product-row-{id}, select-product-{id}, edit-product-{id}, delete-product-{id}, badge-{original|guarantee|new|bonus}-{on|off}, availability-value, set-in-stock, set-out-of-stock, discount-type, discount-value, discount-until, discount-label, apply-discount, extend-discount, remove-discount, price-direction, price-value, price-mode, adjust-price, bulk-delete, page-prev, page-next, page-info, product-edit-modal, edit-name/article/manufacturer/category/price/stock/delivery/description/discount-type/discount-value/discount-until, save-product.
